quote: In our replications, the effect of God salience on AI reliance is not statistically different from zero (Studies 1, 2a, 2b, 3, and 5 produced effect sizes, measured by r, of 0.03, 0.02, 0.03, 0.002, and 0.01, respectively—in contrast to the original effect sizes reported for each of the respective studies of 0.19, 0.15, 0.14, 0.11, and 0.19).
reason: The primary direct replication of Study 5 (included in Fig. 1 and the main results summary) produced r = 0.01, which the authors report as not statistically different from zero and describe as failing to replicate ('why the published effects may not have replicated'). The blind extractor instead targeted an omitted replication of Study 5 that had a typographical error in the experimental materials (r = 0.09) and returned a non-standard label.
